newsitem.title: LEBANON: Israeli warplanes rocket Lebanese hills.
newsitem.headline: Israeli warplanes rocket Lebanese hills.

text.p: Israeli aircraft struck three times at suspected guerrilla targets in southeast Lebanon on Sunday, firing a dozen rockets into hills used as hideouts by Moslem guerrillas, security sources said.

The planes twice hit the eastern side of the central Lebanese mountains overlooking the Bekaa valley, firing eight rockets into remote, rocky hills between the towns of Mashgara and Ain el-Tineh, the sources said.

In a third strike five minutes later they fired four more rockets into the Jabbour hills seven km (four miles) further south, near the edge of Israel's south Lebanon occupation zone, the sources added.
Two aircraft carried out each strike while four others circled overhead.

The sources said the areas hit were used by pro-Iranian Hizbollah (Party of God) guerrillas to launch attacks on Israeli troops in the occupation zone. Large plumes of smoke rose from the strike areas but there were no immediate reports of casualties.
